data.one_liner: Flutter widget that displays Undraw SVG illustrations with caching support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ready‑to‑use UnDraw widget to load and render SVG illustrations from the Undraw library. It includes optional memory and disk caching, placeholders, and error handling.
use_when: You need a large collection of ready‑made illustrations without managing assets yourself
You want easy SVG rendering with built‑in caching in a Flutter app
avoid_when: You require custom illustration sets not covered by Undraw
You need fine‑grained control over SVG parsing beyond what the widget offers
strengths: Built‑in memory and disk caching to improve performance
Simple API with placeholders and error widgets
weaknesses: Relies on network fetch for assets unless cached
data.minimal_example:
UnDraw(
  color: Colors.red,
  illustration: UnDrawIllustration.mobile_application,
  placeholder: Text('Loading...'),
  errorWidget: Icon(Icons.error_outline, color: Colors.red),
  useMemCache: true,
  saveToDiskCache: true,
);
